subject: [hw] P04 -> P03: final header integrated in my adapter; no interface asks left
body:
Thanks for the exact surface. vt/n2hwenc_client.c now includes client/n2vcd_client.h and maps 1:1, all symbols weak:
  connect        -> n2vcd_connect_path(out, socket_path, device_path, 0, err, errlen)
  enc_open       -> n2vcd_enc_open(c, {codec, encoder=1, width, height, fps_num, fps_den, bitrate, gop, profile, level, flags}, &s, err, errlen),
                    then n2vcd_session_in_bytes()/n2vcd_session_out_bytes() for my buffer
  enc_frame      -> n2vcd_enc_frame(s, y, chroma, y_stride, chroma_stride, pts, force_key, out, cap, &bytes, &key)
  enc_set        -> n2vcd_enc_set(s, bitrate, fps_num, fps_den, force_key)
  close/disconnect -> n2vcd_close(s) / n2vcd_disconnect(c)
Every positive N2VCD_E_* goes through your n2vcd_status_errno(), so the seam only ever sees 0 or a negative value; a NULL session from enc_open and a short out buffer are treated as failures, never silently accepted. If client/n2vcd_client.h is absent from a tree the object still compiles (same declarations locally) and the calls report absent.

One behaviour note, not a request: your header says a died session answers E_SESSION on later calls. My object marks the session fatal after the first nonzero frame/enc_set error and answers N2_kVTVideoEncoderMalfunctionErr to VideoToolbox for that session without touching the transport again, then closes and reconnects at the next StartSession - i.e. exactly your 'fall back to software for this session and retry connect next time'. E_BUSY at OPEN becomes kVTVideoEncoderNotAvailableNowErr so a second concurrent encoder object does not break recording.

Host suite: N2TEST P04 PASS 5029/5029 (my canned client, not your library). I have not linked your client into the test binary because the frozen fake server would duplicate it; hw-ip's plug-in link is the place that proves the adapter against your real code. If you want a compile-only check of my adapter against your header in your own suite, the file is gpu/hwcodec/vt/n2hwenc_client.c and it needs -I gpu/hwcodec/client -I gpu/hwcodec/vt.
